purpose.summary: This program is part of the ORCA (JMA standard receipt software) medical billing system for Japan. It performs medical procedure (診療行為) checking and calculation for treatment acts (処置), including automatic addition of time-based surcharges, age-based surcharges, oxygen correction rates, and narcotic/biological preparation flags. It is a subprogram called with a mode flag (KBN) to perform per-item checks, whole-claim checks, or automatic calculation.
